BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our New York City or Toronto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving. You will participate in an on-call rotation covering 8:00am–4:00pm ET.

This is a player-coach role: you'll lead a small team of infrastructure engineers while staying hands-on in the engineering work itself. You'll be an extra set of hands on your team's projects, take on smaller initiatives yourself so the team can stay focused on roadmap work, and help build, shape, and execute our infrastructure roadmap. Expect to spend roughly 60% of your time on hands-on engineering and 40% on leading the team.

What you'll do

Lead the team

  • Lead and develop a small team of talented infrastructure engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback, and career development
  • Help shape a team culture of open communication, craftsmanship, and ownership
  • Take direct responsibility for the quality and delivery of the team's work
  • Participate in hiring and growing the team
  • Protect the team's focus by triaging incoming requests and unplanned work, so engineers can stay on roadmap priorities

Stay hands-on

  • Be an extra set of hands on your team's projects: pair on hard problems, unblock work, review designs and code, and pick up pieces of larger efforts when it helps the team move faster
  • Own and deliver smaller infrastructure initiatives end to end
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation (8:00am–4:00pm ET), act as a technical leader during production incidents, and drive postmortems and follow-up work
  • Champion Infrastructure as Code, automation, and engineering best practices, leading by example

Shape the roadmap

  • Partner with the Head of Infrastructure to build, shape, and execute the infrastructure roadmap
  • Translate long-term goals into concrete, shippable milestones, and plan, estimate, and make tradeoffs with your team
  • Own and be accountable for KPIs covering the reliability, resiliency, and uptime of critical services
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and product teams to identify infrastructure requirements, risks, and opportunities, including cloud cost optimization
  • Facilitate thorough documentation and knowledge sharing

What we're looking for

We are looking for teammates who share and practice our values: open communication, transparency, taking ownership, and a high level of craftsmanship.

Required

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering, building and operating complex, high-stakes production systems
  • 2+ years leading a team of engineers, including people leadership responsibilities such as 1:1s, feedback, and performance conversations
  • A track record of balancing hands-on technical work with team leadership
  • Extensive experience securing, scaling, and operating Kubernetes in production, with associated tooling (ArgoCD, GitOps, Grafana) and advanced Terraform
  • Hands-on experience with a major public cloud provider. We operate primarily on AWS but believe skills in one cloud provider translate to others
  • Strong Linux systems administration skills and networking fundamentals (VPCs, security groups, load balancers, CNI plugins, network policy management)
  • Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language, preferably Go, with strong bash scripting
  • Operational experience with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience participating in and organizing on-call rotations, and leading incident response
  • Strong project management skills and experience collaborating across teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred

  • Security operations experience, including vulnerability management, security monitoring, and incident response
  • Experience with compliance frameworks and audit lifecycles (SOC, ISO, regulators, etc.)
  • Cloud cost optimization and capacity planning experience
  • Deep observability experience (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Loki, ELK)
  • Experience sourcing and hiring engineering talent
  • A history of delivering internal tools or automation that improved developer or operator workflows
  • Blockchain/crypto infrastructure experience, such as running nodes and validators
  • Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

  • Competitive base salary, bonus, and stock options
  • 100% company-paid health insurance for employee, partner, and dependents
  • Up to 4% 401k company match
  • Paid parental leave, Paid vacation
  • Free commuter/parking pass
  • Free custom lunches and snacks
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and an inspiring environment

Benefits may vary based on location.

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $220,000 and $280,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.

descriptions.job-19cdngd:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

The Transaction Reporting Analyst is a critical role responsible for the operational integrity of DriveWealth's regulatory trade reporting. This role is responsible for performing the Firm's front-line supervisory reviews: working exception reports generated across trading, order handling, and FINRA trade reporting activity; investigating and documenting findings; and escalating issues to the appropriate supervisor or principal in line with the Firm's Written Supervisory Procedures (WSPs).
This is an operational, evidence-driven function. It requires the ability to read and apply the Firm's supervisory procedures, work efficiently through exception queues, spot patterns that need escalation, and maintain clean, examiner-ready records of every review performed. Prior experience with order/trade surveillance systems, exception-based reporting, or retail brokerage operations is highly desirable but not required. 

What You’ll Do

  • Perform daily/periodic Level 1 supervisory reviews of assigned exception reports (e.g., trade and order exceptions, CAT/CAIS/TRF/ORF/TRACE supervisory report exceptions)
  • Investigate flagged items to determine root cause, gather supporting evidence, and reach a documented conclusion
  • Clear reviewed items from the queue and log the review, findings, and disposition in the Firm's designated system of record
  • Track issues through to resolution and confirm that corrective action was taken and evidenced
  • Identify recurring exception patterns and recommend process, control, or system improvements to reduce false positives and close gaps
  • Maintain organized, accurate records to support compliance testing, internal audit, and regulatory examinations
  • Assist in gathering facts and documentation in response to regulatory inquiries or exams
  • Partner with Engineering and Brokerage Operations to improve the automation and reliability of monitoring workflows.
  • Stay current on the FINRA rules and internal procedures governing the reviews performed

You Bring

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in a compliance, supervision, operations, or analytical role, preferably at a broker-dealer or other financial services firm
  • Direct exposure to FINRA trade reporting (CAT/CAIS/TRF/ORF/TRACE), SEC Rule 605 and 606 reporting or equivalent regulatory transaction reporting is a plus.
  • Demonstrated background handling regulatory reporting across diverse asset classes, such as Equities, Options, Fixed Income, Futures, and Crypto, is highly desirable.
  • A track record of ownership and disciplined execution in high-stakes, deadline-driven environments.
  • The ability to prioritize effectively and know when to escalate versus resolve independently.
  • Strong written communication skills — able to document findings and escalations clearly and defensibly
  • Impeccable integrity, sound judgment, high attention to detail and a deep respect for risk, control, and regulatory obligations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with SQL, AI-assisted tools (e.g., using AI to summarize, triage, test, or draft first-pass analysis of exception data), or other technical/data skills is a strong plus and will be weighted favorably
  • Active Series 7 required 
  • Series 3, 4, 24 (or willingness to obtain) is a plus

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following location: Chicago, Ilinois - Hybrid

  • This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If you're not based in the location listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $70,000 – $90,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Bonus Points For:

Bullish US LLC & CoinDesk Inc. are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is looking for a senior product strategist-operator to support the Risk team. Risk is central to Stripe’s ability to grow safely: the team protects Stripe and our users while enabling durable, responsible growth. In this role, you will have a front-row seat to high-stakes business and product decisions and a direct hand in helping the team identify emerging risks, prioritize the right interventions, and deliver measurable outcomes. If you are a technical strategist who moves quickly, brings clarity to ambiguity, and stays with difficult problems through resolution, we’d love to hear from you.

You will partner closely with Risk leaders and cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Operations, and Strategy. You will create strategic clarity around Risk’s performance, connect business and product signals, pressure-test plans, and mobilize teams when results are off track. The role combines rigorous analysis with hands-on execution: you will not only identify where Stripe should act, but also help drive the work required to change the trajectory.

We are looking for someone who can connect risk signals, data, financial performance, user impact, and product and business strategy. You can find the signal in the noise, form a clear point of view, and either address the problem directly or convene the right people to solve it quickly.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will work across Risk and Stripe’s technical and user-facing teams to improve decision-making, strengthen execution, and help Stripe manage risk while serving users well.

Responsibilities

  • Own the signal: Define and maintain the metrics that matter for Risk’s in-year performance, spanning risk outcomes, business impact, operational health, and user experience. Build a disciplined “morning read”—a curated, high-signal view that surfaces emerging issues and drives timely action beyond standard dashboarding.
  • Lead deep-dive interventions: Run focused “surge” efforts to diagnose and unblock critical goals at risk. Move from symptom to root cause, align teams on the response, and stay engaged until the trajectory has measurably improved.
  • Bridge Risk, Product, and Strategy: Translate long-horizon company and risk theses into in-year priorities and operating plans. Decompose ambiguous opportunities and threats that cut across Product, Risk, Operations, and go-to-market teams into structured workstreams with clear owners and outcomes.
  • Synthesize for leadership: Anticipate the questions senior leaders will ask and prepare clear, decision-oriented materials that turn complex and unstructured risk signals into diagnoses, options, and recommended actions.
  • Pressure-test assumptions: Work closely with Risk, Corporate Strategy, Product, and Finance to test whether plans reflect external market dynamics, changing risk patterns, user needs, and Stripe’s execution capacity. Identify gaps early and help teams adapt.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in product strategy, business operations, data analytics, product management, or strategic business performance roles, ideally in high-growth technology companies
  • Experience in product strategy, product management, or GM-style roles with direct ownership of a P&L or a specific business outcome
  • Deeply curious about business models and data, probing into signals, understanding trends and customer usage patterns to uncover novel insights
  • A proven track record of directly driving business growth through analytical insights and execution
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI to improve decision-making and operational efficiency, with sound judgment about when and how to use AI tools without sacrificing rigor or quality
  • Strong product sense and the ability to understand the technical mechanics of how software products are built and scaled
  • Experience navigating ambiguous, cross-functional problems and leading high-stakes interventions with senior stakeholders
  • Prior experience with fintech products or complex financial systems is a plus, but not required
  • Experience facilitating senior leadership and stakeholder discussions that lead to clear decisions and action on business performance

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in risk, payments, financial services, or fintech
  • Ability to build trust and partner with senior leaders and CXOs
  • Technical proficiency in SQL / Python / R and data analysis; ability to self-serve and perform independent deep-dives into complex datasets
  • Experience developing creative solutions and influencing the roadmaps of cross-functional teams
  • Ability to anticipate how product launches, policy changes, and go-to-market activity affect risk outcomes, user experience, and support operations
